title: Measured: Deadmines elite ~35 XP per kill at 18 in a 5-man; open-world elite 50
claim: After the Oct 8 dungeon XP buff, a level-18 player in a 5-man (18/18/18/19/20) got 34-36 XP per Deadmines elite (18-22 at level 16 before the buff); the same group got 50 XP per open-world elite, about 43% more.
detail: Single player's measurement (LiWei) in topic 'Actual Numbers Behind This XP Buff', quoted again in the 230-reply 'Let's End this Dungeon XP Argument' thread. Same post: ~16,000 XP needed 18->19, one Deadmines run gives 3-4 XP-bar bubbles of kill XP (about 5-7 runs per level without quests), ~45 min to form a group. Use it to calibrate the dungeon-kill XP model (party of 5, elites) until a second measurement appears. Another poster (#60) claims dungeon mobs give ~15% of outdoor XP, which doesn't match. No Blizzard comment.

title: Community XP/hour claims: questing ~3x faster than dungeon grinding after the nerf
claim: The most-replied leveling thread (230 posts) argues optimized questing gives 50-65k XP/h at 35-40 versus an estimated 15-20k XP/h for spellcleave dungeon grinding after the net ~76% dungeon kill-XP cut; the only beta-measured rate posted is ~16k XP/h world questing at 13-15.
detail: Mostly estimates from pre-Forever Classic videos (SM Cathedral spellcleave 60-80k XP/h, RestedXP questing 50-60k at 35-40); unsourced tiers by another poster: average questing 20-35k, efficient 30-45k+, good spellcleave 40-70k, excellent 70-100k. No Blizzard reply; Blizzard's stated target is parity (n:20261009-dungeon-vs-quest-parity). Calibration only, low confidence.

title: Warlock: Soul Link taken early via Talented does nothing below level 30 (bug)
claim: Soul Link learned before level 30 through the Talented Legacy perk can be cast and costs mana, but applies no buff or damage sharing until the Warlock reaches 30.
detail: Reproduced by several players at 25, 27 and 29 (GitHub #302 comments, EU forum thread). Open, Pending Approval, no designer reply yet. Don't spend Talented/early points on Soul Link while leveling below 30 until fixed.

title: Group quest item drops are round-robin; drop chance unchanged
claim: In a party, quest item drops are distributed round-robin so each member's count stays even; per-mob drop chance is unchanged from Classic and items are still not shared, so a group needs N times the drops.
detail: Josh Greenfield (Aggrend) on X, Sept 26; Icy Veins coverage Sept 26 and Oct 4. Shared mob tagging is not planned. For duo leveling: collection quests take roughly party-size times as many kills; don't plan on groups speeding up drop quests.

title: Escort quest NPCs respawn 5-15 minutes after the previous escort ends
claim: Escort quest givers often reappear only 5-15 minutes after the current escort finishes, so arriving while someone else is escorting can cost up to ~15 minutes.
detail: Icy Veins (Oct 4) on why players level solo. Not confirmed by Blizzard; no per-quest numbers. Coach: if an escort NPC is missing, do nearby objectives and come back rather than wait.

title: Zephras Isle: tornadoes give Blessing of Zephras, +40% run speed for 5 min
claim: On Zephras Isle (Skyborne starting area) small tornadoes grant Blessing of Zephras: +40% run speed for 5 minutes; it survives taking damage but ends on any hostile action you take.
detail: Tornado spawns are not fixed. Quests on the isle are far apart, so route past tornadoes and pick the buff up before long runs; avoid attacking while travelling.

title: RestedXP Forever dungeon guide (WIP): Alliance 15-16 HoT, 16-18 RoL, 18-20 Deadmines
claim: RestedXP's public repo now has a WIP Forever dungeon-leveling guide: Alliance runs 11-15 Darkshore/Westfall questing, 15-16 Hall of Thanes, 16-18 Ruins of Lordaeron, 18-20 Deadmines, then Redridge at 20; Horde has a 12-22 Barrens/Stonetalon/Ashenvale variant.
detail: Files Guides/Forever/dungeon/*.lua, tagged #beta and '(WIP) Dungeon Guide 1-20'; updated Oct 11 (Ruins of Lordaeron travel fix). Useful as a reference dungeon-leg order; RXP's Oct 12 commit also turned off Hunter Darkshore cooking stops and says to build Basic Campfires while waiting for boats, not on them.

title: Dual spec unlocks at 40 (50g); Blizzard considering 30
claim: Dual specialization currently unlocks at level 40 for 50 gold; Josh Greenfield said on the Forever podcast (episode 3) it could move to 'a cheeky thirty'.
detail: Not decided. Matters for leveling only as a free leveling/dungeon spec swap from 40 (or 30).

title: Legacy perk Master Chef: up to 50% chance of an extra cooked item
claim: The Legacy professions perk Master Chef (5 ranks, unlocks after 5 points in the tree) gives up to a 50% chance to create an extra result when cooking.
detail: Rank count and gate from client-derived data (forever-guides LegacyTrees.lua, spell 1225457); the 50% figure is from one EU forum post. Halves the materials for crafted food (+5% kill XP buff, n:20261009-crafted-food-5pct-kill-xp). Beta players say it already crashed cooked-food prices on the AH.

title: Ding: free open-source Forever 1-60 leveling guide addon
claim: Ding (moust4ki/DingWowForever, CurseForge 'ding-xp-and-leveling-guide') ships free Alliance and Horde 1-60 routes generated offline from QuestieDB for XP per hour; 30-60 is untested in game.
detail: Needs QuestieDB-Forever (separate download). Routes never take quests above your level+1, skip poor-value detours, include new Forever quests. Gamepad-first UI. A data source for route comparison (Ding/Guides/Alliance|Horde, tools/route_solver.lua).
